ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: Provides free dialysis services to poor patients suffering from kidney failure at district hospitals.
benefits: Free or subsidized hemodialysis sessions for below-poverty-line patients at designated government hospitals.
eligibility: Patients requiring dialysis, priority given to BPL category
Availed at designated district hospital dialysis centres
application_steps: Get referred to the district hospital's dialysis unit by a treating physician
